text: dsh-wsl-suite 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 WSL 工作区支持：通过侧栏入口浏览发行版目录并添加工作区，为工作区会话生成 WSL 预设变体，让文件操作、shell 命令和 grep/glob 搜索在发行版内的常驻 Node agent 中执行，并让侧栏终端进入对应发行版。它适合在 Windows 上使用 Linux 工具链处理项目的 DSH 用户；需要可用的 WSL2 发行版及发行版内 Node.js 和 ripgrep。

dsh-wsl-suite adds WSL workspaces to DSH. Browse Linux directories in a sidebar, then use WSL file tools, shell commands, grep/glob, and a matching terminal from the workspace session. Requires a WSL2 distribution with Node.js and ripgrep.
我想让 DSH 会话直接在 WSL 发行版里访问项目文件。
能从侧边栏浏览 Linux 目录并把文件夹添加成工作区吗？
让 DSH 的 shell 命令在 WSL 里运行。
代码搜索能否用 WSL 里的 grep 和 glob？
I want my DSH workspace tools to work on files inside a WSL distribution.
Can the DSH sidebar open a Linux terminal for my WSL workspace?
dsh-wsl-suite 的功能「添加 WSL 工作区」：通过侧栏 W 入口选择发行版并浏览 Linux 目录，将所选目录加入宿主工作区注册表。
dsh-wsl-suite 的功能「发行版内文件操作」：WSL filesystem provider 经常驻 agent 提供文件读写、目录遍历等操作，并使用发行版内路径。
dsh-wsl-suite 的功能「WSL shell 与搜索」：shell provider 在发行版内执行命令，grep 和 glob 工具调用发行版自身的 rg。
dsh-wsl-suite 的功能「WSL 会话终端」：当会话工作目录是 WSL UNC 路径时，将侧栏终端启动请求改写为 wsl.exe 调用并进入对应 Linux 路径。
我希望同一个 DSH 预设能切换到 Linux 环境处理代码。
Run my DSH session tools against files and commands inside WSL.

dsh-wsl-suite README · dsh-wsl-suite：WSL workspaces for DeepSeek Harness. A rebuild of
[`dsh-wsl-workspace`](https://github.com/dsh-wsl-workspace-maintainers/dsh-wsl-workspace)
on a different substrate: **one persistent agent process inside the distribution**,
reached over a JSON-lines pipe, instead of a 9P file share plus a spawn per command.

dsh-wsl-suite README · Acknowledgments：This plugin stands on the shoulders of
[`dsh-wsl-workspace`](https://github.com/dsh-wsl-workspace-maintainers/dsh-wsl-workspace)
by **Yuntao Liu ([@6Mikao9](https://github.com/6Mikao9))** and its maintainers.
That plugin proved the workflow this one serves — adding a WSL workspace from
the sidebar and running a whole session inside the distribution — and its
client design (the header-entry mount, the add-workspace dialog, the
footer-seat fallback) is the blueprint `src/client/` follows. The rebuild
changes the substrate, not the ideas: thank you.

dsh-wsl-suite README · Acknowledgments：Please file dsh-wsl issues here, and direct `dsh-wsl-workspace` questions to
its own repository.

```
browser ──POST /dsh-wsl/api──▶ host plugin ──pipe──▶ node agent.mjs (in distro)
                                     │                        │
                                     └── ctx.fs / ctx.shell ◀─┘
```

dsh-wsl-suite README · Why the substrate changed：Measured on this machine against a live Ubuntu distro:

| operation | 9P share (`//wsl.localhost/…`) | one `wsl.exe` spawn per call | this agent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stat` | 4.3 ms | 212–282 ms | **0.20 ms** |
| `readdir` | 2.8 ms | 212–282 ms | **0.25 ms** |
| run a command | — | 212–282 ms | **13–20 ms** |
| glob a 5.2 GB repo (64,625 files) | 44 s (and misses ~half the tree) | — | **0.59 s** |

Three consequences follow, and all three are the point of the rebuild:

dsh-wsl-suite README · Why the substrate changed：- **No polling.** The old plugin swept the share every 3 s and walked it every 30 s so
  it could notice changes. Against a share, each sweep is a batch of multi-millisecond
  metadata calls that reaches into the distro and, when WSLg is on, pulls focus to the
  Windows desktop every half minute. The agent is asked on demand, so those timers are
  gone rather than tuned — nothing touches the distro while it is idle.
- **`/mnt/<drive>` works.** A 9P share serves `ext4` only; the drvfs mounts are
  invisible to it, which forced the old plugin to reroute those paths to Windows
  drive letters and to synthesize `/mnt` entries by probing every drive. Inside the
  distribution `/mnt/c` is just a directory, so the rerouting and the probe are deleted
  along with the class of bug where a workspace key and its path disagreed.
- **Search runs in the distribution.** `grep` and `glob` are the shipped tools backed by
  a packaged Windows `ripgrep`, which against a share is not merely slow: a whole-home
  walk took **44 s** over 9P versus **0.29 s** in-distro, a content search **150 s**
  versus **0.79 s**, and the 9P run returned 22,436 lines whe

dsh-wsl-suite README · What it does for you：- **Add a WSL workspace from the sidebar.** In the Workspaces section header, press the
  **W** button beside the shipped “添加工作区” control (it falls back to a bottom-list
  entry when the header is absent). The dialog lists your installed distributions and
  browses the Linux filesystem; “添加此文件夹” registers the folder through the host's
  own workspace registry — a WSL workspace is just a host workspace whose path is a UNC
  path (`\\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\you\…`), so there is exactly one record and no
  private store to drift.
- **The sidebar terminal follows the session in.** A session whose workspace is a WSL
  path opens its terminal *inside* the distribution — a real bash with a real pty
  (input, output and resize all round-trip). Windows-cwd sessions are untouched.
- **The model gets WSL-native tools.** A `wsl-<mode>` twin of every healthy preset
  replaces the shell/fs tools with the WSL ones and adds `grep`/`glob` that run the
  distro's own ripgrep — including `/mnt/<drive>` and unreadable-directory tolerance
  (exit 2 keeps the partial results instead of failing the call).
- **Localized.** The dialog follows `navigator.languag

dsh-wsl-suite README · What is in here：| file | role |
| --- | --- |
| `agent/agent.mjs` | zerodep Node script run inside the distro: `stat`, `lstat`, `readdir`, `read`, `readRange`, `write`, `mkdir`, `remove`, `realpath`, `exec`, `kill`, `ping` over JSON lines. Reconstructs the login environment once at startup so `--exec` still sees `~/.local/bin`. |
| `src/channel.ts` | host side of that pipe: spawns the agent, pairs replies by id, idles closed after 10 minutes (idle = no request outstanding, so a 30-minute test run is never killed), one channel per distro, reopen-on-death. |
| `src/shell.ts` | `WslShellExecutor extends ShellExecutor` — exit codes, stream split, live streaming, timeout that kills the process group, tail-preserving output cap, background handles whose unobserved rejection can never kill the host. |
| `src/fs.ts` | `WslFileSystem extends FileSystem` — 12 primitives, version-guarded writes, `FS_STALE_VERSION`/`FS_AMBIGUOUS_EDIT`/`FS_NOT_TEXT` handling, sandbox fencing, atomic write by rename, and **byte-faithful CRLF**: the seam's LF normalization applies to the reported `before`/`after` only, never to the bytes on disk. |
| `src/search.ts` | the `grep` and `glob`

dsh-wsl-suite README · The sidebar seat：The **W** control mounts beside the shipped add-workspace button in the Workspaces
section header — the treatment the old `dsh-wsl-workspace` plugin shipped. The header is
host-private (no slot declares it), so `src/client/hostEntry.ts` mirrors the reference's
technique: walk up from the footer action's own DOM element to
`[class*="_sectionHeader"]` / `[class*="_headerActions"]`, inject a `<span class="dww-header-slot">`
and React-render `HostEntryButton` into it with the add button's own class list, and
observe the strip because React re-renders drop unknown children. The strip's 60 px cap
is widened to 92 px while the entry is seated (`max-width: 92px` in
`src/client/styles.ts`) or the third button is clipped; the shipped-hidden variant keeps
it collapsed.

dsh-wsl-suite README · The sidebar seat：The footer entry stays registered on `sidebar.footer.action` (a `list` slot,
`replaceRisk: "none"`, fresh id `dsh-wsl-suite`) — hidden while the header seat is present,
and the fallback when the header is absent (rail sidebar, a release that renames the
classes). It is also the anchor the header discovery walks up from.

dsh-wsl-suite README · The terminal：The sidebar terminal is *not* driven by the `terminals` registry, so adding a terminal
backend does not reach it. `terminalController` gets its environment from
`agent.ctx.get('subprocess')` and calls `subprocess.spawnTerminal(...)` directly. That
service is single-slot and `agent.ctx` sits outside any preset group, so a preset cannot
provide a WSL one — isolation only propagates to descendants, and the preset registry
rejects a service that leaks into the host realm.

dsh-wsl-suite README · The terminal：What it can do instead is wrap the host provider's `spawnTerminal` in place, which
`src/terminal.ts` does. The discriminator is already in the request: a session inside a
distribution has a UNC cwd, and the wrapper rewrites that one call into

wsl.exe -d <distro> --cd <linux cwd> -- <shell>

so the host's own ConPTY carries a real Linux pty — input, output and `resize` all
round-trip. Sessions with a Windows cwd pass through untouched, byte for byte.

dsh-wsl-suite README · The terminal：`resolveExecutable` and `terminalEnvironment` are deliberately left alone: they answer
host-wide questions (which `bash.exe` exists on Windows) and only feed shell *discovery*
and argument building. The shell that actually starts is chosen here — the requested POSIX
shell name is passed into the distribution (`/bin/zsh`, `/bin/fish`, …, falling back to
`/bin/bash`), so the distro's own shells are honored.

dsh-wsl-suite README · Preset variants, not a mode：The shell dialect has to change with the world: outside a distribution the agent runs
`pwsh`, inside it runs `bash`. So instead of a global routing provider, every healthy
preset in the profile gets a `wsl-<mode>` twin (`standard` → `wsl-standard`) whose shell
and file tools are the WSL ones. The rest of the preset — persona, skills, jobs,
delegation — is carried through untouched.

dsh-wsl-suite README · Preset variants, not a mode：The transform matches rows by `id` in the parsed document, which makes it immune to the
indentation fragility that made a nested `subagent` row invisible to the original
(`tool "subagent" is already registered in this scope`). It also clears a `disabled: !!js
process.platform === 'win32'` gate off a row it lifts into the world: that expression is
evaluated by the loader on the host, so carrying it along would disable the very tool the
variant exists to provide.

dsh-wsl-suite README · Preset variants, not a mode：`!!js` expressions survive the round trip as `{__jsExpr: …}` nodes, which is the shape the
host loader itself tests for, so a re-registered preset still evaluates its own gates.

dsh-wsl-suite README · Installing, updating, verifying：**From npm (the normal way).** The published name is `dsh-wsl-suite`; the bundle
and its rows are named the same. In the profile directory:

```sh

dsh-wsl-suite README · in C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\：pnpm add dsh-wsl-suite          # or: npm install dsh-wsl-suite
```

then add `"dsh-wsl-suite"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in that profile's `package.json`
and restart the harness.
sh
pnpm add "dsh-wsl-suite@github:stallenlu/dsh-wsl-suite"
```

`github:` specs are fetched as a tarball, so the copy is replaced wholesale on every
push — no `file:`-style remove/reinstall dance.
text
dsh-wsl-suite README · source of truth — edit here：C:\Users\GT14\Documents\deepseek-harness\wsl-rework\next\

dsh-wsl-suite README · the copy the harness actually loads (a FILE COPY, not a symlink)：C:\Users\GT14\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-wsl-suite\
```

Because the installed copy is a copy, every source change needs a reinstall; from a
DeepSeek Harness session:
sh
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:<gui-port>/dsh-wsl/api \
  -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"method":"listDistros"}'
section: the copy the harness actually loads (a FILE COPY, not a symlink)

text:
dsh-wsl-suite README · → {"ok":true,"value":{"distros":[{"name":"Ubuntu","default":true}]}}：```

`check` and `listDir` go through the persistent in-distro agent, so a 200 with real
entries proves the whole pipe.

dsh-wsl-suite README · Developing：```sh
npm install          # devDependencies pin the 0.2.1-rc.5 host surface
npm run typecheck
npm run build        # lib/{index,fs,shell,search,client}.js
npm test             # 60 checks; live ones skip when no distro is present

dsh-wsl-suite README · Developing：`tests/live.test.ts` runs against a real distro and skips — rather than fails — when
`wsl.exe -l -q` returns nothing, so the suite is honest on a machine without WSL.
`tests/client.test.ts` loads the built bundle the way the host's loader does, so `npm test`
builds first (`pretest`); that is the only place the browser half is checked, because
`tsconfig.json` excludes it.

dsh-wsl-suite README · Deliberate non-goals：- **No `fs.watch`.** The distro's filesystem cannot be watched from the host; the sidebar
  file browser swallows the resulting `workspace-file/watch-unsupported` code and does a
  one-shot refresh instead. The reference plugin had no watch either.
- **`sandboxMode` is `undefined`.** The WSL VM is the boundary; there is nothing inside it
  for the host's sandbox policy to fence.
- **No `wsl_terminal` model tool / persistent-shell terminal door / workspace context-menu
  items.** The old plugin's model-side terminal and menu hack are superseded: the model
  uses the persistent channel (structured exit codes and streams, faster than driving a
  pty), and people use the sidebar terminal, which now enters the distribution on its own.

[`dsh-wsl-workspace`](https://github.com/dsh-wsl-workspace-maintainers/dsh-wsl-workspace)
及其作者 **刘云韬（[@6Mikao9](https://github.com/6Mikao9)）** 与各位维护者的工作。
那个插件验证了本插件所服务的完整工作流——从侧栏添加 WSL 工作区、让整个会话
跑在发行版内——它的客户端设计（标题栏入口挂载、添加工作区弹窗、footer
席位回退）正是 `src/client/` 遵循的蓝图。本插件换的是基座，不是想法：

dsh-wsl 的问题请在本仓库提 issue；`dsh-wsl-workspace` 本身的问题请到它

dsh-wsl-suite README · 致谢：```
浏览器 ──POST /dsh-wsl/api──▶ 宿主插件 ──管道──▶ node agent.mjs（发行版内）
                                    │                       │
                                    └── ctx.fs / ctx.shell ◀─┘
```

dsh-wsl-suite README · 为什么换基座：在本机对真实 Ubuntu 发行版实测：

| 操作 | 9P 共享（`//wsl.localhost/…`） | 每次调用一个 `wsl.exe` spawn | 本 agent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stat` | 4.3 ms | 212–282 ms | **0.20 ms** |
| `readdir` | 2.8 ms | 212–282 ms | **0.25 ms** |
| 跑一条命令 | — | 212–282 ms | **13–20 ms** |
| 对 5.2 GB 仓库 glob（64,625 个文件） | 44 s（且漏掉约一半目录树） | — | **0.59 s** |

由此带来三个后果，也是重写要达到的全部目的：

dsh-wsl-suite README · 为什么换基座：- **不再轮询。** 旧插件每 3 s 扫一遍共享、每 30 s 走一遍目录树来感知变化。
  对共享而言每轮巡检都是一串多毫秒的元数据调用，会伸进发行版，而且 WSLg
  开着时每半分钟把焦点拉到 Windows 桌面一次。现在 agent 是按需被问询的，
  所以这些定时器是被删掉而不是被调优——空闲时没有任何东西碰发行版。
- **`/mnt/<盘符>` 可用。** 9P 共享只服务 `ext4`，drvfs 挂载对它不可见，
  这逼得旧插件把这些路径改路由到 Windows 盘符、靠探测每个盘来合成 `/mnt`
  条目。在发行版内 `/mnt/c` 只是个目录，改路由和探测随之删掉，连同
  「工作区键与它的路径不一致」这一类 bug 一起消失。
- **搜索在发行版内执行。** 旧插件的 `grep`/`glob` 是宿主工具，靠打包的
  Windows ripgrep 对共享跑：整仓走一遍 **44 s**（9P）对比发行版内
  **0.29 s**，内容搜索 **150 s** 对比 **0.79 s**，而且 9P 那次返回 22,436
  行、原生返回 41,838 行——悄悄漏了约一半目录树。所以 WSL 变体换上
  `search-wsl`，通过 agent 跑发行版自己的 `rg`。同一个 `glob '*.toml'`
  查询 2.3 s 返回 891 个文件。

dsh-wsl-suite README · 它为你做什么：- **从侧栏添加 WSL 工作区。** 在「工作区」分区标题栏，按自带「添加工作区」
  控件旁的 **W** 按钮（标题栏不存在时回退到底部列表入口）。弹窗列出已安装
  的发行版并浏览 Linux 文件系统；「添加此文件夹」通过宿主自己的工作区
  注册表登记——WSL 工作区只是路径为 UNC（
  `\\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\you\…`）的宿主工作区，只有这一条记录，
  没有会漂移的私有存储。
- **侧栏终端跟着会话进发行版。** 工作区是 WSL 路径的会话，其终端*在发行版
  内*打开——真正的 bash 配真正的 pty（输入、输出、resize 全部回环）。
  Windows cwd 的会话原样不动。
- **模型拿到 WSL 原生工具。** 每个健康预设都有一个 `wsl-<mode>` 孪生变体
  （`standard` → `wsl-standard`），把 shell/fs 工具换成 WSL 版，并新增跑
  发行版自带 ripgrep 的 `grep`/`glob`——覆盖 `/mnt/<盘符>`，对不可读目录
  宽容（exit 2 保留部分结果而不是让整次调用失败）。
- **已本地化。** 弹窗跟随 `navigator.language`：`zh-*` 显示简体中文，
  其余英文。

dsh-wsl-suite README · 目录里有什么：| 文件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `agent/agent.mjs` | 发行版内运行的零依赖 Node 脚本：`stat`、`lstat`、`readdir`、`read`、`readRange`、`write`、`mkdir`、`remove`、`realpath`、`exec`、`kill`、`ping`，走 JSON lines。启动时重建一次登录环境，`--exec` 也能看到 `~/.local/bin`。 |
| `src/channel.ts` | 管道的宿主侧：拉起 agent、按 id 配对回复、10 分钟空闲即关（空闲 = 无未完成请求，30 分钟的测试跑不会被杀）、每个发行版一条通道、死后重开。 |
| `src/shell.ts` | `WslShellExecutor extends ShellExecutor`——退出码、流分离、实时流、杀进程组的超时、保尾输出上限、后台句柄（其未观察的 rejection 永远不会杀死宿主）。 |
| `src/fs.ts` | `WslFileSystem extends FileSystem`——12 个原语、版本守卫写入、`FS_STALE_VERSION`/`FS_AMBIGUOUS_EDIT`/`FS_NOT_TEXT` 处理、沙盒围栏、rename 原子写，以及**逐字节保真的 CRLF**：接缝的 LF 归一化只作用于上报的 `before`/`after`，永不动磁盘字节。 |
| `src/search.ts` | `grep` 和 `glob` 工具，ripgrep 在发行版**内**执行。 |
| `src/terminal.ts` | 让侧栏终端跟着 WSL 会话进去：包装宿主唯一的 `subprocess.spawnTerminal`，UNC cwd 改写为 `wsl.exe -d <distro> --cd <linux> -- <shell>`。 |
| `src/client/index.tsx` | 浏览器半边：**W** 标题栏入口（经 `src/client/hostEntry.ts`），底部列表入口作回退兼发现锚点；添加工作区弹窗（`src/client/styles.ts` 只用 `--dsw-*` 令牌 styling，`src/client/locale.ts` 放中英文字符串）。 |
| `src/host/variants.ts` | 预设变换：把 agent 预设改写成它的 WSL 变体。只操作**解析后的行**，不碰缩进。 |
| `src/rows.ts` | `wsl-world` 组：`shell-wsl` + `fs-wsl` + `search-ws

dsh-wsl-suite README · 侧栏席位：**W** 控件挂在「工作区」分区标题栏里自带添加按钮旁——旧
`dsh-wsl-workspace` 插件的处理方式。标题栏是宿主私有的（没有任何 slot 声明
它），所以 `src/client/hostEntry.ts` 沿用参考插件的手法：从 footer
action 自己的 DOM 元素向上走到
`[class*="_sectionHeader"]` / `[class*="_headerActions"]`，注入一个
`<span class="dww-header-slot">`，用添加按钮自己的类名列表把
`HostEntryButton` React 渲染进去，并观察该条带（React 重渲染会丢弃陌生
子节点）。条带 60 px 的宽度上限在入口就位期间放宽到 92 px（
`src/client/styles.ts` 里的 `max-width: 92px`），否则第三个按钮被裁切；
shipped-hidden 变体则保持收起。

dsh-wsl-suite README · 侧栏席位：底部入口仍注册在 `sidebar.footer.action`（`list` 型 slot、
`replaceRisk: "none"`、新 id `dsh-wsl-suite`）——标题栏席位在场时隐藏，标题栏
缺席时作回退（rail 侧栏、发版改了类名）。它也是标题栏发现向上走的锚点。

dsh-wsl-suite README · 终端：侧栏终端*不由* `terminals` 注册表驱动，加终端后端够不着它。
`terminalController` 从 `agent.ctx.get('subprocess')` 取环境，直接调
`subprocess.spawnTerminal(...)`。该服务是单槽的，`agent.ctx` 在任何预设组
之外，所以预设无法提供 WSL 版——隔离只向后代传播，预设注册表还会拒绝泄进
宿主域的服务。

它能做的是原地包装宿主 provider 的 `spawnTerminal`，`src/terminal.ts` 就是
这么干的。判别信息本来就在请求里：发行版内的会话 cwd 是 UNC，包装器把这一
次调用改写成

wsl.exe -d <发行版> --cd <linux cwd> -- <shell>

于是宿主自己的 ConPTY 带起一个真正的 Linux pty——输入、输出、`resize` 全部
回环。Windows cwd 的会话逐字节原样通过。

dsh-wsl-suite README · 终端：`resolveExecutable` 和 `terminalEnvironment` 有意不动：它们回答的是宿主级
问题（Windows 上哪个 `bash.exe` 存在），只参与 shell *发现*和参数拼装。真正启动的
shell 在这里决定——请求的 POSIX shell 名会被带进发行版（`/bin/zsh`、`/bin/fish`……，
找不到就退回 `/bin/bash`），发行版自己的 shell 都能跟随。

dsh-wsl-suite README · 预设变体，不是全局模式：shell 方言必须随世界改变：发行版外 agent 跑 `pwsh`，发行版内跑 `bash`。
所以不做全局路由 provider，而是给 profile 里每个健康预设一个 `wsl-<mode>`
孪生（`standard` → `wsl-standard`），其 shell 与文件工具换成 WSL 版。
预设其余部分——人设、技能、任务、委派——原样带过。

变换按 `id` 在解析后的文档里匹配行，因此对原版那种「嵌套 `subagent` 行
不可见」（`tool "subagent" is already registered in this scope`）的缩进脆弱
性免疫。它还会把被抬进 world 的行上的 `disabled: !!js
process.platform === 'win32'` 门清掉：该表达式由加载器在宿主上求值，带过去
会恰好禁用这个变体要提供的工具。

`!!js` 表达式以 `{__jsExpr: …}` 节点形状在往返中保留——这正是宿主加载器
自己测试的形状，所以重新注册的预设仍会求值自己的门。
section: 预设变体，不是全局模式

dsh-wsl-suite README · 安装、更新、验证：**从 npm 安装（常规方式）。** 发布名是 `dsh-wsl-suite`（`dsh-wsl` 因 npm 防山寨规则不可注册），bundle
与其中各行同名。在 profile 目录里：

```sh

dsh-wsl-suite README · 在 C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\ 下：pnpm add dsh-wsl-suite          # 或：npm install dsh-wsl-suite
```

然后在同一文件的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里加 `"dsh-wsl-suite"` 并重启 harness。

**从 GitHub 安装。** 结果相同，适合版本还没发到 registry 之前：sh
pnpm add "dsh-wsl-suite@github:stallenlu/dsh-wsl-suite"
```

`github:` 规格按 tarball 拉取，每次推送整体替换副本——没有 `file:` 那套
remove/reinstall 流程。

`check` 和 `listDir` 走发行版内的常驻 agent，所以 200 加真实条目即可证明
整条管道通。

dsh-wsl-suite README · 开发：```sh
npm install          # devDependencies 钉住 0.2.1-rc.5 宿主接口
npm run typecheck
npm run build        # lib/{index,fs,shell,search,client}.js
npm test             # 60 项检查；live 的在没有发行版时跳过而非失败

`tests/live.test.ts` 对真实发行版运行，`wsl.exe -l -q` 无输出时跳过——
所以在没有 WSL 的机器上套件依然诚实。`tests/client.test.ts` 按宿主加载器
的方式加载构建产物，所以 `npm test` 先构建（`pretest`）；那是浏览器半边
唯一被检查的地方，因为 `tsconfig.json` 排除了它。

dsh-wsl-suite README · 有意不做：- **不做 `fs.watch`。** 宿主侧无法监听发行版的文件系统；侧栏文件浏览器会
  吞掉随之产生的 `workspace-file/watch-unsupported` 码并做一次性刷新。
  参考插件同样没有 watch。
- **`sandboxMode` 保持 `undefined`。** WSL 虚拟机本身就是边界，宿主沙盒
  策略在它内部没有可围栏的东西。
- **不做 `wsl_terminal` 模型工具 / persistent-shell 终端门 / 工作区右键
  菜单项。** 旧插件的模型侧终端和菜单 hack 已被取代：模型走常驻管道
  （结构化退出码与流，比驱动 pty 更快），人走侧栏终端，而侧栏终端现在
  自己就能进发行版。
